name: Dynamic Warm-Up
steps: March in place for 30 seconds, swinging your arms.
Do 10 slow arm circles forward and 10 backward.
Do 10 hip circles each way and 10 gentle bodyweight squats.

name: Cool-Down Stretch
steps: Walk slowly for one minute until your breathing settles.
Hold each stretch for 20–30 seconds: quads, hamstrings, calves, chest, shoulders.
Breathe deeply and never stretch into pain.

name: Brisk Walk
steps: Walk at a pace where you can talk but not sing.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and swing your arms.
Land heel to toe and keep your head up.

name: March in Place
steps: Stand tall and lift your knees to hip height alternately.
Swing your opposite arm with each step.
Keep a steady rhythm and breathe evenly.

name: Step-Ups
steps: Use a sturdy step or bottom stair.
Step up with one foot, bring the other up, then step down.
Alternate the leading leg every minute.

name: Shadow Boxing
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hands up.
Throw controlled jabs and crosses in the air.
Stay light on your feet and keep your core tight.

name: Jumping Jacks
steps: Start standing with feet together.
Jump feet out while raising arms overhead.
Jump back and repeat at a steady pace.

name: High Knees
steps: Run in place driving your knees up to hip height.
Pump your arms and stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.

name: Mountain Climbers
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch quickly.
Keep your hips low and your back flat.

name: Burpees
steps: Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Return your feet in and jump up with arms overhead.

name: Jump Squats
steps: Lower into a squat with chest up.
Explode upward, leaving the ground.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

name: Sit-to-Stand (Chair Squat)
steps: Sit on the front of a sturdy chair, feet hip-width apart.
Stand up by pushing through your heels without using your hands.
Lower slowly back down with control.

name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to about 90°.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.

name: Lunges
steps: Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are about 90°.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.

name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second, then lower slowly.

name: Calf Raises
steps: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance if needed.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower slowly with control.

name: Wall Sit
steps: Lean your back against a wall and slide down until your knees are about 90°.
Keep your knees over your ankles and breathe normally.
Hold, then slide back up.

name: Wall Push-Up
steps: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands on it at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start.

name: Knee Push-Up
steps: Start on hands and knees, hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with a straight line from head to knees.
Press back up.

name: Push-Ups
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest to just above the floor, elbows at 45°.
Press up while keeping your body in one straight line.

name: Chair Dips
steps: Sit on a sturdy chair edge, hands beside your hips.
Slide forward and lower your body by bending your elbows to 90°.
Press back up without shrugging your shoulders.

name: Shoulder Taps
steps: Start in a high plank with feet wide for stability.
Tap one shoulder with the opposite hand.
Keep your hips still and alternate sides.

name: Superman
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold for a second and lower slowly.

name: Bird Dog
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Extend your right arm and left leg until level with your back.
Return and switch sides without rotating your hips.

name: Reverse Snow Angels
steps: Lie face down, arms by your sides, palms down.
Lift your chest slightly and sweep your arms out and overhead.
Sweep back down with control.

name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent over hips.
Lower your opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed down, then switch sides.

name: Plank Hold
steps: Rest on your forearms and toes with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line and your glutes tight.
Breathe steadily for the prescribed time; stop early if your hips sag or your lower back hurts.

name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, hands lightly behind your head.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Alternate sides in a slow, controlled pedal.

name: Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie flat with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Raise your legs to vertical keeping your lower back down.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.

name: Knee Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side, forearm under your shoulder, knees bent.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from knees to head.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Cat-Cow
steps: On hands and knees, arch your back and look up (cow).
Round your back and tuck your chin (cat).
Move slowly with your breath.

name: Single-Leg Balance
steps: Stand near a wall or chair for support.
Lift one foot slightly and balance on the other leg.
Switch legs after the hold.

name: Incline Push-Up
steps: Place your hands on a sturdy table, counter or sofa edge, a little wider than your shoulders, and step your feet back until your body is one straight line.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the surface, then press back up. Keep your tummy gently tight.
Use a higher surface to make it easier and a lower one to make it harder.

name: Wide Incline Push-Up
steps: Place your hands on a sturdy table or counter, clearly wider than your shoulders, and walk your feet back into a straight line.
Lower your chest between your hands, keeping your elbows slightly angled back, then press up.
Stop if you feel pinching at the front of your shoulders.

name: Close-Hand Incline Push-Up
steps: Place your hands close together under your chest on a sturdy table or counter and walk your feet back into a straight line.
Lower your chest toward your hands with your elbows close to your sides, then press up.
This works the backs of the arms more than a standard push-up.

name: Wide Push-Up
steps: Start in a plank with your hands wider than your shoulders and your body in one straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor, then press back up without letting your hips sag.
If this is too hard, do it on your knees or with your hands on a table.

name: Close-Hand Push-Up
steps: Start in a plank with your hands closer than shoulder width and your body in one straight line.
Lower your chest toward your hands, keeping your elbows close to your sides, then press back up.
If this is too hard, do it on your knees or with your hands on a table.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, then lift one leg so your knee points up.
Press through the planted heel to lift your hips until your body is a straight line from shoulders to knee.
Lower slowly. Finish all repetitions on one side, then switch.

name: Kneeling Glute Kickback
steps: Get on your hands and knees on a mat, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keeping your knee bent, lift one leg until your thigh is in line with your back, squeezing your buttock. Do not arch your lower back.
Lower with control and finish all repetitions on one side before switching.

name: Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, hands lightly at the sides of your head with your elbows wide.
Breathe out and curl your head and shoulders a short way off the floor, keeping your chin off your chest.
Lower slowly. Do not pull on your neck.

name: Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides and your knees bent above your hips.
Breathe out and curl your hips a short way off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Lower slowly without swinging your legs.

name: Side Crunch
steps: Lie on one side with your knees slightly bent and your top hand lightly behind your head.
Breathe out and lift your top shoulder toward your hip, using the side of your tummy.
Lower slowly. Finish all repetitions on one side, then switch.

name: Cross-Body Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, hands lightly behind your head.
Breathe out, lift one shoulder and turn to bring it toward the opposite knee.
Lower and alternate sides.

name: Heel Touches
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, about shoulder width apart, arms by your sides.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly and reach your right hand toward your right heel.
Return to centre and reach toward the left heel. Keep the movement small and controlled.

name: Seated Twist
steps: Sit with your knees bent and feet on the floor, lean back slightly with a long straight back and your hands together in front of your chest.
Turn your chest to one side, then the other, in a slow controlled way.
Keep your feet on the floor to make it easier. Stop if your lower back complains.

name: Bent-Knee Leg Lift
steps: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides and your knees bent about 90 degrees.
Lift your feet a few centimetres off the floor, keeping your lower back gently pressed down.
Lower slowly. Do not let your back arch.

name: Plank Knee Drive
steps: Start in a straight-arm plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one foot and bring that knee out toward the same elbow, then return it.
Alternate sides slowly, keeping your hips level.

name: Star Jump
steps: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Hop and spread your arms and legs out wide, then hop back to the start. Land softly on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent.
Stop and rest if you feel any pain in your knees or ankles.

name: Jumping Lunge
steps: Stand in a lunge position with one foot forward and your hands on your hips.
Hop and switch your legs in the air, landing softly in a lunge with the other foot forward. Keep your front knee over your foot.
Keep the hops low and controlled. Use a regular lunge instead if your knees or balance are a concern.

name: Standing Hip Circles
steps: Stand holding a wall or chair, lift one knee to about hip height.
Slowly draw circles with your knee, five in each direction.
Switch legs.

name: Arm Circles
steps: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Make slow circles about the size of a dinner plate, breathing normally.
Reverse direction halfway.

name: Shoulder Rolls
steps: Stand or sit tall with your arms loose.
Roll your shoulders forward, up, back and down in a slow circle.
Reverse direction halfway.

name: Ankle Circles
steps: Hold a wall or chair and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Draw slow circles with your toes, five in each direction.
Switch feet.

name: Wrist Circles
steps: Hold your arms out in front of you with relaxed fists.
Rotate your wrists slowly, five circles in each direction.
Keep the rest of your body still.

name: Child's Pose
steps: Kneel on a mat and sit back toward your heels, then reach your hands forward along the floor.
Let your head rest and breathe slowly into your back.
If your knees complain, place a folded towel behind them or skip this one.

name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
steps: Lie on your back and loop a towel or belt around the ball of one foot.
Gently straighten that leg toward the ceiling until you feel a mild stretch behind the thigh.
Hold, breathe, then switch legs.

name: Calf Stretch at the Wall
steps: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it and one foot stepped back, heel flat on the floor.
Bend the front knee and lean in until you feel a mild stretch in the back calf.
Hold, then switch legs.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Kneel on a mat with one foot forward in a lunge position.
Tuck your tailbone under and shift forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Hold, then switch sides. Pad your knee with a towel if needed.

name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Stand with one foot a step in front of the other and your knees slightly bent.
Tuck your tailbone under and press your hips gently forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
steps: Lie on one side with your bottom knee bent for balance.
Bend your top knee and hold your foot or ankle, bringing your heel gently toward your buttock.
Hold, then roll over and switch sides.

name: Lying Glute Twist
steps: Lie on your back with one leg straight and the other knee bent.
Guide the bent knee across your body toward the floor with the opposite hand, keeping your shoulders down.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Single Knee to Chest
steps: Lie on your back and pull one knee toward your chest, holding behind the thigh (not on the kneecap).
Keep the other leg relaxed and your lower back resting on the floor.
Hold, then switch legs.

name: Both Knees to Chest
steps: Lie on your back and bring both knees toward your chest.
Hold behind your thighs, not on your kneecaps, and breathe slowly.
Release gently.

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
steps: Sit with one leg straight and the other foot resting against your inner thigh.
Lean forward from your hips with a long back until you feel a mild stretch behind the straight leg.
Hold, then switch legs.

name: Triceps Stretch
steps: Reach one hand behind your head and down your back.
Use the other hand to ease your elbow gently back and up.
Hold, then switch arms.

name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
steps: Bring one arm straight across your chest.
Hold it with the other hand just above the elbow and draw it gently closer.
Hold, then switch arms.

name: Standing Chest Opener
steps: Stand tall and place your hands on your lower back with your elbows out.
Draw your elbows gently back and lift your chest until you feel a mild stretch across the front.
Hold and breathe normally.

name: Upper Back Stretch
steps: Clasp your hands in front of you with your palms turned out.
Reach forward and round your upper back, letting your head drop gently.
Hold and breathe normally.

name: Seated Spinal Twist
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Turn your upper body to one side, holding the chair back or your thigh, keeping your hips facing forward.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Standing Side Bend
steps: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and your knees soft.
Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the opposite side, with your other hand on your hip.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Overhead Reach
steps: Stand tall and interlace your fingers, turning your palms up toward the ceiling.
Reach up with your shoulders relaxed and your ribs gently drawn in.
Hold and breathe normally.

name: Inchworm
steps: Stand tall, then bend forward and place your hands on the floor (bend your knees as much as you need).
Walk your hands forward to a plank, pause, then walk them back to your feet.
Stand up slowly.

name: Lunge with Rotation
steps: Step into a long lunge and place both hands on the floor inside your front foot.
Lift the inside hand toward the ceiling, turning your chest open, and follow it with your eyes.
Return the hand to the floor, then switch sides.
